$comment: App-size baseline for measure-nativeaot.mjs. Every number is a DELTA in bytes over the
gamebase row, never an absolute size, so it survives .NET SDK patch drift and runner
The linux-x64 entry below is transcribed from docs/guides/il2cpp-size-protocol.md §3, which
recorded those deltas on .NET 8 NativeAOT linux-x64. It has never been re-measured on a
GitHub runner, so it ships with "gate": false: differences are reported as advisory
warnings and in the job summary instead of failing the build. The shape invariants in
measure-nativeaot.mjs (profile ordering, falling per-method cost, H-FIELDS no-op, SLIM a net
win, reflection-free build runs) are enforced regardless — those are ratios, not bytes.
To turn the byte gate on: run the app-size job once on a runner, confirm the reported
numbers are sane, then run `UPDATE_SIZE_BASELINE=1 node tests/app-size-bench/measure-nativeaot.mjs`
on that same runner and commit the rewritten file — it records the measured deltas with
"gate": true. Same regeneration idiom as UPDATE_DELIVERY_GOLDENS.
